# Surface parity

<!-- Generated by `make parity` from applyuminati.surface_parity. Do not edit. -->

What each of the four surfaces — CLI, API, TUI, web — can do, and the address it does it at. `—` means the surface cannot do it at all, which is a product finding, not a missing row.

| Capability | Summary | CLI | API | TUI | Web |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `initialise` | Create a new install: data directories, schema, config file, password. | `init` | — | — | — |
| `run-doctor` | Check that the install works: database, source backends, LLM, config. The API route is the backend half only, and there is no whole-install check on the TUI or the web app; both show per-backend health instead. | `doctor` | `GET /api/v1/health/backends` | — | — |
| `capabilities-matrix` | Print the plugin capability and maturity matrix. | `capabilities` | — | — | — |
| `dashboard` | Pipeline totals, recommendation split, and the latest run. | `status` | `GET /api/v1/dashboard` | `1:dashboard` | `/` |
| `list-sources` | List the registered job sources and their health. | `sources list` | `GET /api/v1/sources` | `4:sources` | `/settings` |
| `enable-source` | Turn a job source on. | `sources enable` | `POST /api/v1/sources/{slug}/enable` | `4:sources` | `/settings` |
| `disable-source` | Turn a job source off. | `sources disable` | `POST /api/v1/sources/{slug}/disable` | `4:sources` | `/settings` |
| `source-options` | Per-source query, location, and company filters. The API carries them in the enable body; the CLI can only set them in config.toml. | — | `POST /api/v1/sources/{slug}/enable` | `4:sources` | `/settings` |
| `discover` | Fetch new jobs from the enabled sources. | `jobs discover` | `POST /api/v1/jobs/discover` | — | `/` |
| `list-jobs` | Browse and filter the jobs that have been discovered. | `jobs list` | `GET /api/v1/jobs` | `2:jobs` | `/jobs` |
| `job-detail` | Everything about one job, with its fit score. | — | `GET /api/v1/jobs/{job_id}` | `2:jobs` | `/jobs/:id` |
| `score` | Score jobs against the active profile. | `jobs score` | `POST /api/v1/jobs/score` | — | `/jobs` |
| `apply` | Start an application attempt for a job. In the TUI: key 2, then a. | `applications apply` | `POST /api/v1/jobs/{job_id}/apply` | `2:jobs` | `/jobs/:id` |
| `execution-mode` | Choose research_only versus submit. The CLI and web pick it per application; the TUI applies with the configured mode and offers no choice. | `applications apply` | `POST /api/v1/jobs/{job_id}/apply` | — | `/jobs/:id` |
| `list-applications` | Browse applications and where each one has got to. | `applications list` | `GET /api/v1/applications` | — | `/applications` |
| `needs-you` | The handoff queue: attempts stopped, waiting on a human. | — | `GET /api/v1/needs-you` | `3:needs_you` | `/needs-you` |
| `resolve-handoff` | Answer, skip, or keep control of a waiting attempt. | — | `POST /api/v1/needs-you/{attempt_id}/{intervention_id}` | `3:needs_you` | `/needs-you` |
| `open-browser-handoff` | Hand the attempt to a paired browser host. | — | `POST /api/v1/needs-you/{attempt_id}/open-browser` | `3:needs_you` | `/needs-you` |
| `import-profile` | Import a JSON Resume as the active profile. | `profile import` | `POST /api/v1/profile/import` | `6:profile` | `/profile` |
| `export-profile` | Write the active profile back out as a JSON Resume. | `profile export` | — | — | — |
| `view-profile` | Read the active profile and its claim levels. | — | `GET /api/v1/profile` | `6:profile` | `/profile` |
| `edit-preferences` | Change target titles, locations, seniority, and compensation. | — | `PUT /api/v1/profile/preferences` | — | `/profile` |
| `edit-strategy` | Turn the search/apply dials: depth, volume, thresholds, autonomy. The CLI has no settings command at all. | — | `PUT /api/v1/settings/strategy` | `5:settings` | `/settings` |
| `browser-hosts` | Pair, list, and revoke the browsers that take handoffs. | `browser-host list` | `GET /api/v1/browser-hosts` | — | — |

## Coverage

7 of 24 capabilities are reachable on all four surfaces: `dashboard`, `list-sources`, `enable-source`, `disable-source`, `list-jobs`, `apply`, `import-profile`.

17 are missing on at least one surface:

- `initialise` — no API, TUI, Web
- `run-doctor` — no TUI, Web
- `capabilities-matrix` — no API, TUI, Web
- `source-options` — no CLI
- `discover` — no TUI
- `job-detail` — no CLI
- `score` — no TUI
- `execution-mode` — no TUI
- `list-applications` — no TUI
- `needs-you` — no CLI
- `resolve-handoff` — no CLI
- `open-browser-handoff` — no CLI
- `export-profile` — no API, TUI, Web
- `view-profile` — no CLI
- `edit-preferences` — no CLI, TUI
- `edit-strategy` — no CLI
- `browser-hosts` — no TUI, Web
